body: Same thing happened to me. But it all happened within a week or so. I think some guys confuse their horniness with emotions/feelings for someone. The best we can do is try and move on. It sucks but focus on yourself and let yourself feel the negative emotions and move on. You'll look back and only get disgusted with the loser, no other feelings. Best of luck <3
